title: Finite projective dimension of the residue field is at most the Krull dimension
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] with residue field $\kappa=R/\mathfrak m$, and let $\dim R\in\{0,1,2,\dots\}\cup\{\infty\}$ be its Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring] (the supremum of the lengths $l$ of chains $\mathfrak p_0\subsetneq\dots\subsetneq\mathfrak p_l$ of prime ideals of $R$). If $\kappa$ has finite projective dimension as an $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-finite-global-dimension], then $\operatorname{pd}_R\kappa\le\dim R$; in particular, if $\dim R$ is finite, $\kappa$ has a projective resolution of length $\le\dim R$.

proof.text: Apply Ring.residueField_projectiveDimension_le_depth to bound projective dimension by depth.
Apply IsLocalRing.depth_le_supportDim to R and rewrite Module.supportDim_self_eq_ringKrullDim (Mathlib) to obtain the first conclusion.

For ringKrullDim R = D, compose the first inequality with this equality and use CategoryTheory.projectiveDimension_le_iff to obtain HasProjectiveDimensionLE kappa D. Apply the bounded-resolution bridge [lem-weil-pbc-projective-resolution-ext-degree] to construct the required projective resolution of length at most D.

lean.statement:
lemma residueField_projectiveDimension_le_ringKrullDim
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (h : ModuleCat.HasFiniteProjectiveDimension
      (ModuleCat.of R (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))) :
    CategoryTheory.projectiveDimension (ModuleCat.of R (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)) ≤
        ringKrullDim R ∧
      ∀ D : ℕ, ringKrullDim R = (D : WithBot ℕ∞) →
        ModuleCat.HasProjectiveResolutionLE
          (ModuleCat.of R (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)) D
